title: Evidence card
responsibility: Presents one screenshot or audio gallery entry with its recorded status and provenance.

inputs.name: EvidenceCard.item
inputs.description: Required evidence record. Media classification selects screenshot or audio display. For screenshots, missing flag or image-load error disables opening and changes displayed status to not-proven.

inputs.name: EvidenceCard.before
inputs.description: Optional original recording. For audio items, presence selects a paired comparison card; otherwise audio is rendered individually. Ignored for screenshots.

inputs.name: EvidenceCard.assetBase
inputs.description: Required prefix concatenated with screenshot files or passed to audio playback.

inputs.name: EvidenceCard.onopen
inputs.description: Required callback invoked by screenshot or paired-audio opening controls. Individual audio playback uses its own controls.

inputs.name: EvidenceCard.compact
inputs.description: Optional screenshot presentation: false by default. True keeps provenance in a Capture details disclosure beneath the image. Audio rendering is unchanged.

outputs.name: EvidenceCard
outputs.description: Screenshot card with lazy image, title anchor, category, status, provenance and optional viewport/time. Missing screenshots show a placeholder and note. Audio delegates to its single or paired card. The component does not verify evidence bytes.
